summary: Iteration 6 testing: Referral program, Resale estimator, Loan optimizer, Portfolio vs-investments (sold+rental), Disclaimer pages. All 30 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Loan optimizer returns costs_monthly as a float (not a dict). Per spec it should be a 'costs_monthly' block — may need to be structured as {maintenance, tax, emi, total} for richer UI. Currently functional but flat value.
Carry-over from iteration 5: Help FAB still blocked by 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay (z-index issue). Not retested in this iteration.
seed_data_creation: Several referrer/referred test users registered during referral flow testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 6 features pass. Backend: /api/referrals/me returns referral_code+stats, register with referral_code extends referrer's plan +30 days, resale-estimate and loan-optimizer are public endpoints returning correct fields and math. vs-investments includes series data with year/property/equity/mutual_funds/gold fields. Frontend: nav-referrals sidebar link (Invites), /app/referrals page shows all testids (referral-code, referral-link, referral-copy, referral-share, referral-total, referral-days, referral-reward, referral-events). Calculators has 6 tabs with tab-resale + tab-optimizer; both run buttons and result sections work with optimizer grid rows (optimizer-row-5 through optimizer-row-100). /disclaimer page public and working. Disclaimer inline/compact visible on calculators and referrals pages. Register ?ref=CODE pre-fills invite field. Outstanding carry-over: Help FAB blocked by Emergent badge overlay (z-index issue from iteration 5).
rca_of_issue: No new critical bugs found. All 6 major features for iteration 6 are fully functional end-to-end.
